_help: Save folders Record-GamePlay.ps1 backs up after each game (Backup-GameSaves). Paths are relative to the frontend root; * matches one folder level. A set is zipped only when one of its files changed, into <dest>\<COMPUTERNAME>\<set>\slot-1..keep.zip (rotating: old versions are overwritten, never deleted - NAS recycle bin rule). TeknoParrot / PC games keep saves in their own folder: files the game wrote there during play (up to learnMaxMB each) are learned per game and backed up as 'game-<id>'.

sets.name: Dolphin Triforce
sets._note: not StateSaves: there they are the collection's boot snapshots (~20 MB each), not player progress
